scope: Source-bound mapping only; no production implementation and no numerical acceptance threshold.

newton_iteration_order: copy current state%h to workspace old_head
on convergence leave loop without another jacobian_F
accepted_state_vs_stored_jacobian.conclusion: The dfdh arrays left in worker scratch after convergence are the Jacobian assembled at the pre-update old_head of the final Newton iteration, not an exactly rebuilt Jacobian at the accepted candidate state.

restricted_swkimpl0_linearization.scope: Current F-SI23/F-SI24 unsaturated B1.10 reference route with SwKimpl=0, explicit top flux, bottom mode 5, macropores inactive and derivative-free frozen source/sink inputs.
restricted_swkimpl0_linearization.conductivity_semantics: Node and face conductivities are evaluated from the time-level-n/base head before the Newton loop and are not refreshed during Newton when SwKimpl=0.
restricted_swkimpl0_linearization.off_diagonal_semantics: dfdh_upper/lower are therefore fixed from base-time face conductivities and grid distances for the full solve.
restricted_swkimpl0_linearization.main_diagonal_semantics: Each Newton Jacobian rebuild changes the storage/capacity contribution dimoca*dz/dt while retaining the fixed off-diagonal conductivity terms; prescribed bottom head adds the frozen bottom-face conductance term.
required_inputs: constitutive provider evaluated at base head for frozen conductivities
constitutive provider evaluated at accepted head for accepted-state capacity
boundary mode and prescribed bottom head semantics
restricted_swkimpl0_linearization.reason: Other modules must not depend on HeadCalc internal arrays or reproduce its numerical implementation; invariant 22 requires a solver-owned hydraulic/operator interface.

architectural_candidate_seam.name: solver_owned_linearized_operator_evaluation
architectural_candidate_seam.purpose: Allow the Richards solver itself to evaluate/reconstruct the linearized semi-discrete operator for an explicitly supplied state and numerical/boundary context, without exposing HeadCalc internal arrays to process modules.
logical_inputs: base/committed state where the current linearization policy freezes required coefficients
logical_outputs: tridiagonal operator coefficients or an opaque linear-action/solve handle
operator provenance identifying the state and policy at which it was built
